text:
elaine_sales: Hey team — running a POC with FinCustInc next week. They asked for a concise ops/security checklist for an EU-only POC + a subprocessor attestation list we can share. Also asked about any SLA exceptions for egress and KMS regional availability. Can we put together the docs by EOD? :hourglass: 

 tom_solutions: I can draft the checklist. Quick q: will the POC use hosted API (tenant pin) or Dedicated? That changes the routing options and pricing.

 elaine_sales: Hosted for now, they want a temporary tenant pin to EU region. If feasible we'll discuss Dedicated after POC. They also want a short attestation CSV rather than a long doc.

 maria_security: High level: we need to confirm subprocessors that touch request routing (CDN, ingress), KMS providers, and any cloud regions. They asked for SOC2 + DPA references. We should include a statement on data passporting (what crosses borders) — simple yes/no per step.

 anjali_ops: Ops notes: we can pin a tenant to eu-west-1 region for the POC via routing policy, but full edge activation for a new region is ~4-6 weeks (approval + cert rotation + subnet provisioning). For a short POC we can do temporary routing with egress through eu-west-1 — caveat: cross-region fallback still possible if capacity constrained.

 kevin_legal: Sales, ensure NDAs inbound before sharing detailed subprocessors. We can provide our standard DPA and a redacted subprocessor list if needed. If customer needs full subprocessor contracts we need an escalation. Also need to flag export-control constraints for certain models.

 elaine_sales: Noted. Customer is ok with redacted list first. They specifically asked for: (1) a CSV attestation list of subprocessors + last attested date, (2) an operations checklist (network certs, KMS region + TTL), and (3) an egress pricing delta for EU-only routing vs default.

 tom_solutions: Drafting CSV sample now — will attach. For pricing, rough POC numbers: hosted EU-only egress surcharge ~ $0.02/GB extra (depends on destination), KMS regional key add-on ~ $300/mo if we manage dedicated CMKs in eu-west-1. Dedicated reserved capacity reduces per-token and egress unit rates, but out of scope for this POC.

 maria_security: For attestation schema, please include these columns (minimal): `region, subprocessor_name, role, data_types_processed, certs (SOC2/ISO), last_attested_at, contact_email, notes`

 tom_solutions: CSV header I'll use: 
```
region,subprocessor_name,role,data_types_processed,certs,last_attested_at,contact_email,notes
```
I'll populate with redacted contact emails.

 anjali_ops: Operational checklist (short):
- confirm tenant pin + routing policy
- verify eu KMS key present and IAM bindings
- firewall egress rules (allow to our eu ingress endpoints)
- cert rotation window scheduled (we suggest 72h maintenance)
- monitor prefix/KV cache warmup for latency baseline

 maria_security: Also add: DPA signed, data passport table (yes/no per processing step), subprocessors redaction level, and retention window agreed.

 elaine_sales: Perfect. Can we get the CSV + checklist + a one-pager egress pricing note by EOD so I can send to FinCustInc?

 deploy-bot: [region-capacity] eu-west-1 currently at 78% GPU capacity, 90% CPU buffer. No outages reported.

 anjali_ops: I'll prepare the short checklist + ops caveats and drop in the thread in ~2 hours.

 tom_solutions: CSV draft attached below (redacted entries):
```
region,subprocessor_name,role,data_types_processed,certs,last_attested_at,contact_email,notes
eu-west-1,REDACTED-A,ingress,request-meta,SOC2,2026-02-10,redacted@example.com,CDN+LB
eu-west-1,REDACTED-B,kms,keys-only,ISO27001,2026-01-15,redacted@example.com,managed CMK
```

 maria_security: Quick callout — for any subprocessor without SOC2 we need compensating controls listed. Add a column `compensating_controls` if present.

 tom_solutions: good call. updating CSV header now.

 kevin_legal: I'll queue the DPA and ask for the NDA token from sales. Once NDA is inbound we can share the redacted contracts.

 elaine_sales: I'll get the customer's NDA today. Thanks all. Action items: tom = CSV + pricing one-pager, anjali = ops checklist + routing caveats, maria = security attestation guidance, kevin = DPA/NDA check. Will follow up in this thread. :thumbsup:
